My background

My work in
applied economics.

I study applied economics and development policy at the Université d’Abomey-Calavi. My work focuses on West African economies, including agriculture, structural transformation and digital adoption.

Master’s thesis · under review

Digitalisation and structural transformation in ECOWAS economies

My thesis examines whether digital adoption is associated with industrialisation and more diversified exports. It covers fifteen ECOWAS countries from 2000 to 2023.
